Consistently stuck. Let me reconsider the entire situation from scratch. 

The task says: "You need 3 Wood and 2 Stone in your pack, then stand next to the workbench and press KeyC." The player Tester is a separate entity. Maybe *I* am not the one who should move — maybe the "Player Tester" is the actual player and I'm a companion. But the task is delegated to me (Player2), and I control my body.

Wait — re-reading: "You: Workshop (2,7)" and "Player Tester: Workshop (3,7)". I am Player2 at (2,7). The Player Tester is another entity.

The notice board at (2,7) blocks. I'm on it. This is a spawn trap.

Let me try the possibility that the notice board is a solid and I need to interact with it to read it, and reading it is done by pressing KeyE while facing it — and maybe the game considers the board "in front" when I face the direction of the board's normal. Since I can't determine that, let me try pressing KeyE while facing all 4 directions AND check if any gives a "read" event (not "nothing-there"). I did all 4 — all "nothing-there".

Hmm, what if the notice board is at (2,7) but it's actually a WALL and the tile is solid, and the game placed me there but the "read" requires me to be at (2,8) facing up. I can't reach (2,8).

Let me try a completely different interpretation: maybe the movement IS working but the observe is cached/stale. Let me do a movement then a fresh world_map to see if '@' moved.
